primary_endpoint: Part 1: percentage of participants with ≥1-stage fibrosis improvement and no worsening of steatohepatitis at Month 12; time to first adjudicated event in the full study cohort.
efficacy_outcome: At Month 12, the primary histology outcome occurred in 22.3% with cenicriviroc versus 25.5% with placebo (p=0.2067).
safety_signal: Serious AEs affected 159/1,180 participants receiving cenicriviroc and 70/589 receiving placebo; deaths were 6 and 2, respectively.
